title: 서북도서방위사령부령 / queue:ARTICLE:4:0:00004:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 4 (Duties of Commander, etc.)
(1) Except where the Commander is subject to the operational command and supervision of the Chairman of the Joint Chiefs of Staff under Article 9 (3) of the Act on the Organization of the Armed Forces, the Commander shall, under the direction of the Chief of Naval Operations, exercise overall control over the affairs of the Northwestern Islands Defense Command and command and supervise units subordinate or attached thereto.
(2) The Commander may exercise operational control over operational units of the respective armed services reinforced to the northwestern islands where necessary for the conduct of joint operations.
(3) The Deputy Commander shall assist the Commander and perform the Commander's duties on an acting basis if the Commander is unable to perform them due to unavoidable circumstances.
(4) The Chief of Staff shall assist the Commander and coordinate and control staff duties.
